description: This file defines the ContentDao interface, which extends a generic DAO to manage Content entities. It provides methods for retrieving Content and ContentDescription objects based on various filters such as content type, store, language, code, and seUrl.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content based on the specified ContentType, store, and language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by multiple ContentTypes, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a Content object by its code and store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a Content object by its code, store, and language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by ContentType and store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by ContentType and store.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Lists ContentDescription objects, excluding non-visible content, filtered by ContentType, store, and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Gets a Content object by its ID and Language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves ContentDescription by store and SEO URL.
